title: Forking & Upstream Syncing
introduction: Welcome to Part C: Real-World Collaboration! How do you contribute to a repository you don't own — like React, VS Code, or an open-source library? You cannot push directly to their repository. Instead, you **Fork** it! Today you learn the Fork & Pull Request workflow used across the global open-source community.
why_it_matters: Forking allows anyone in the world to experiment and contribute improvements to any open-source project safely. Understanding how to link your fork to the original `upstream` repository ensures your fork never becomes outdated.
practical_activity_preview: Fork an open-source starter repo on GitHub, clone your fork locally, and configure an `upstream` remote.
